summary.text: MediShield Life gives lifelong protection for large medical bills, unlike many other healthcare plans.

details.heading: Why you need it
details.body: All Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents must join MediShield Life. It protects you for life, even if you have very large medical bills or become very sick.

details.heading: How other plans differ
details.body: Employer healthcare cover may end when you leave work or retire. Private insurance may end if you cannot pay the premiums. You may also be unable to re-apply, or may face exclusions for health conditions you already have.

details.heading: Help with premiums
details.body: The Government supports premiums for people who need help and cannot pay.

quotes.text: Under MediShield Life, Singapore Residents will receive lifelong protection for large medical bills.
All Singapore Citizens and Permanent Residents are required to join MediShield Life.
Unlike MediShield Life, other healthcare coverage is not guaranteed for life.
The Government provides support for premiums for the needy who are unable to pay.
